decision.summaryForCoordinator: ACCEPT at 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX. Nineteen attacks run, nineteen refuted. The subject is a genuine remeasurement of frozen v1 onto live HEAD f76aa87 / file 08 f909ddff / required-now 28, with the 26→28 delta exactly accounted for by D-167 and D-169 and file 08 confirmed moved. The obligation and leftoverDesign sets are provably identical to v1. Every v5-derived content claim, the D-103 recording, the DR-113 deferral target, and the gates-2-and-3 failure all verify against their sources.
